reviewer: One assistant; no independent panel or participation by the named developers.

reviews.observation: A rule subclass scans methods and constructs diagnostics.
reviews.dhh_lens: Do not remove the named rule contract.
reviews.otwell_lens: Keep the check and its diagnostic creation together.
reviews.counterexample: A rule subclass scans methods and constructs diagnostics.

reviews.observation: AST filtering and a diagnostic with derived location; extends Check.
reviews.dhh_lens: The rule is a useful named operation.
reviews.otwell_lens: Construction follows an actual detection decision.
reviews.counterexample: AST filtering and a diagnostic with derived location; extends Check.

reviews.observation: Scanning eval nodes produces diagnostics; not a create-only class.
reviews.dhh_lens: An explicit rule entry point has a concrete purpose.
reviews.otwell_lens: Removing it would obscure the supported check.
reviews.counterexample: Scanning eval nodes produces diagnostics; not a create-only class.

reviews.observation: Scanning magic methods produces diagnostics; not a factory.
reviews.dhh_lens: Keep the rule boundary.

reviews.observation: Validates class names, creates a selected type and stores rule instances.

reviews.observation: Constructor checks extension availability and initializes handler state.

reviews.observation: Handler selects formatter options and validates message types.

reviews.observation: Private static helper inspects closures using ReflectionFunction.

reviews.counterexample: Private static helper inspects closures using ReflectionFunction.

reviews.observation: TraceableCommand uses ReflectionMethod to select interactive delegation.

reviews.observation: DigestAuth validates challenge parameters and populates DigestChallenge.

reviews.observation: TLS cache validates capacity, hosts and fingerprint data.

reviews.observation: Condition is inside a callback, uses instanceof and calls; class extends Check.

reviews.counterexample: Condition is inside a callback, uses instanceof and calls; class extends Check.

reviews.observation: Conditions use local paths and str_starts_with; one is a return expression.

reviews.counterexample: Conditions use local paths and str_starts_with; one is a return expression.

reviews.observation: Predicate is a nested callback over a node; class extends Check.

reviews.counterexample: Predicate is a nested callback over a node; class extends Check.

reviews.observation: Visitor extends NodeVisitorAbstract; conditions use a node and local booleans.

reviews.otwell_lens: No repeated own-state predicate is established.
reviews.counterexample: Visitor extends NodeVisitorAbstract; conditions use a node and local booleans.

reviews.observation: Predicate is in an arrow function, with instanceof and a method call.

reviews.counterexample: Predicate is in an arrow function, with instanceof and a method call.

reviews.observation: Nesting limit uses a parameter and comparison; object check uses is_object.
reviews.dhh_lens: Formatting remains with its data traversal.
reviews.otwell_lens: Different input-dependent decisions should not be merged.

reviews.observation: Inherited handler chooses a highest record using local values and calls.

reviews.counterexample: Inherited formatter has distinct scalar, newline and exception checks.
